original_datasets.notes: domlow is missing for some households (1295 non-missing). Outcome totinc is heavily right-skewed; analyses use log(totinc). Categorical variables (e.g., caste, electric, borrow) require factor coding. File located at data/AEJApp-2009-0289-data/household.dta.

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Use log(total income) as outcome; run a one-sided t-test by domlow; fit OLS with robust SE including broad controls and domlow; report domlow effect; perform twofold Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition on log income by domlow.
preprocessing_steps: Encode categorical variables (e.g., caste, borrow, electric).
Log-transform totinc to handle skew and outliers.
Compute one-sided t-test of log(totinc) between domlow==1 and domlow==0.
Fit OLS models with robust (HC0) standard errors including specified controls and domlow.
Run twofold Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition (Reimers equal weights) for log(totinc) by domlow.
